alignment_method.pixel_bounds: floor(index * image_dimension / grid_dimension); exact normalized pixel bounds are stored per coarse cell and fine child
alignment_method.exact_mapping: Each 4x4 cell (r,c) is the union of 8x8 cells (2r,2c), (2r,2c+1), (2r+1,2c), (2r+1,2c+1).
alignment_method.primary_fine_pooling: Area-weighted mean of the four 8x8 signed score-drop densities; equivalently sum(fine score_drop) / sum(fine area_fraction).
alignment_method.primary_comparison: Direct 4x4 signed score-drop density versus area-pooled 8x8 signed score-drop density across 16 aligned regions.
alignment_method.spearman: Average ranks for ties; no clipping of negative values.
alignment_method.area_weighted_spearman: Sensitivity summary: weighted Pearson correlation of average-rank vectors using exact 4x4 pixel-area fractions.
alignment_method.secondary_additive_diagnostic: Compare direct 4x4 raw score_drop with the sum of its four 8x8 child score_drops; descriptive only, not an assumption that perturbation effects are additive.
alignment_method.negative_values: Preserved as signed values; no clipping, absolute-value transform or removal.
alignment_method.lost_detection_handling: LOST target score is zero under the frozen protocol; baseline-minus-zero score_drop is numeric and retained.

interpretation_boundary: Descriptive spatial rank agreement between single-cell perturbation-sensitivity maps on the same eight development-exposed images and ten frozen targets. Maps use different mask sizes and detector responses are nonlinear; this is not independent-sample inferential evidence, external explanation ground truth, causal faithfulness, worker-compliance validation or evidence of A5/A6 policy superiority. Targets share images and the 16 cells within each target are spatially dependent; no inferential p-values or confidence claims are made.
